name: SeekOut
tagline: Agentic AI recruiting — source, screen, and engage talent at scale.
description: SeekOut is an enterprise recruiting platform with autonomous AI agents that search 1B+ candidate profiles across external sources and your ATS, surfacing talent via signals like patents, GitHub, and publications. It adds AI video screening and personalized outreach, plus People Insights labor-market analytics for skills-gap and competitive talent analysis.
insight: Raised a $115M Series C led by Tiger Global in Jan 2022 at a $1.2B valuation.
edge: Pairs deep technical sourcing (patents, GitHub, publications) with enterprise talent analytics — more breadth than pure sourcing or screening tools.

references.title: Tiger doubles down on SeekOut, which just raised $115M
